article.title: US Reviews China’s Offshore Access to Nvidia Chips After AI Breakthroughs
article.summary: A key US agency is reviewing how Chinese AI firms acquire and access Nvidia Corp. chips overseas, following a spate of technological breakthroughs that highlighted their ability to use the cutting-edge hardware despite Washington’s restrictions on shipments to the Asian country.

article.title: Cloudflare讓網站免改程式啟用WebMCP，AI代理可直接使用網站功能
article.summary: Cloudflare推出WebMCP開發者預覽，啟用後，Cloudflare會在網頁送到瀏覽器前自動加入一段橋接程式，讓支援WebMCP的AI代理發現網站提供的功能，並直接呼叫對應工具。網站管理者可直接在Cloudflare控制臺開啟功能，不必修改原有網站程式。

article.title: Google reveals how much free space Chrome wants to install local AI models
article.summary: TL;DR Google has updated its support documentation to show that downloading the models that power Chrome’s on-device AI features requires approximately 20 gigabytes of available storage space. The install size of the models is still approximately 4 GB, Google has confirmed. You can disable Chrome’s on-device AI features in the browser’s settings. Google’s been working for a while to integrate Gemini more deeply into Chrome for some time now. Some users were confused and annoyed this spring when Chrome started automatically downloading a multi-gigabyte file called weights.bin that enables Gemini Nano features to run locally. Now, Google’s updated its documentation to reflect that you’ll actually need quite a bit more free space to actually download the files required for local AI features.

article.title: Google Maps just added a feature that lets you order food without leaving the app
article.summary: Credit: Karandeep Singh / Android Authority TL;DR Google Maps is getting food ordering, smarter personalized recommendations, a live transit widget, and conversational map edits through Ask Maps. Food ordering and conversational contributions are launching in the US first, while the live transit widget and personalized features are rolling out wherever Ask Maps is available. Ask Maps is also expanding to Australia, Brazil, Canada, Indonesia, Japan, Mexico, and more than 150 countries and territories in English. Google has announced several new features coming to Google Maps through Ask Maps , including the ability to order food directly from the app, more personalized recommendations powered by your Google data, a live transit widget, and conversational map edits.

article.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
article.summary: Kitesurf is a cloud-hosted browser designed for AI agents instead of people. It uses less computing power than Chromium for common automation tasks, helping developers build browser-based AI agents more efficiently.
